## First Place at the Deloitte x DCU Student Business Consulting Case Competition!🎉 

Last week, we had the incredible opportunity to act as strategy consultants for Apple’s entry into the AI market through Apple Intelligence. 

The challenge? Develop a persuasive solution and presentation in just 8 hours - a true test of teamwork adaptability, and strategic thinking. 

This was my first case competition with such tight constraints and a team I met that very morning. Drawing on my internship experience, past presentations, and coursework in Business Strategy and Managing Digital Change and Transformation at Dublin City University, I led our team to success. 

A special thanks to my teammates, Karol Koszorz and Marleen Danzenbächer (first year Global Business students at DCU Business School) for their outstanding contributions and initiative. 

Excited to take on more consulting challenges in the future!
